method: Read-only SQLite inventory plus conservative rendered-label inspection; no recovery engine was invoked.

decision: A nonempty section_map is authoritative but not complete. Union native map claims with same-kind text recovery, then deduplicate exact section identities/ranges; do not treat map presence as section coverage complete.
